A1.justification: Both PDFs describe BIOEMU-CV and provide readable main text, equations, figures, tables and complete appendices. Retained content can be matched across the appendix reorganization, distinguishing relocations from deletions.

before.justification: v2 reports original OPES and steered-MD simulations on three proteins and alanine dipeptide, alongside state-discrimination, sensitivity and ablation results.

after.justification: v3 retains original protein simulations and analyses, including the quantitative results in Tables 1–5 and the appendix ablations.

M1.justification: v3 removes the auxiliary TBG-CV adaptation from v2 Appendix C.6, including its TBG backbone, GNN-node conditioning and autocorrelation loss. The central BIOEMU-CV procedure, frozen BioEmu backbone, encoder/MLP conditioning and Equation 1 remain unchanged.

E1.justification: The alanine-dipeptide study of transitions between C5 and C7ax disappears with v2 Appendix C.6. Coverage of Chignolin, Trp-cage and BBA, including their free-energy estimation and transition-path tasks, is retained.

E2.justification: The explicit dihedral-angle comparator Ref (phi, psi) in v2 Table 11 disappears with the alanine experiment. DeepTICA, TAE and VDE remain in the protein comparisons; the Trp-cage PCA/TICA comparisons also remain, relocated to Appendix C.3.

E3.justification: Removed evaluation configurations include the four-dimensional BBA encoder study and alanine-specific 20 ns OPES simulations and 256-path SMD evaluation. The retained protein experiments preserve their training splits, metrics, simulation budgets and RMSD mixing; no rerun or protocol revision is established.

E4.justification: v3 removes the dedicated alanine multipathway study and four-dimensional BBA sensitivity/state-discrimination analysis in v2 Appendices C.6–C.7, substantially narrowing supplementary validation of alternative backbones and multidimensional behavior. Figure 4 adds a smaller Chignolin intermediate-state diversity illustration. Time-lag, freezing, encoder and RMSD-mixing ablations are retained in Appendix B.

E5.justification: The retained experiments preserve repeat counts, standard-deviation reporting and the OPES outlier-exclusion rule. Figure 2 changes 'four seeds' to 'four simulations', while the text still specifies four independent simulations; this does not establish a changed uncertainty procedure.

E6.justification: Matched protein tables and retained appendix results have unchanged values. Removed results include v2 Table 11's alanine comparisons, such as TBG-CV's 60.93% target-hit percentage, and Figure 17's four-dimensional BBA findings. v3 Figure 4 adds qualitative Chignolin intermediate-state observations.

T1.justification: The Langevin dynamics, CV and committor definitions, Equations 1–4, and the no-time-lag ablation objective remain mathematically unchanged. Neither version adds distinct theorem or proof material.

C1.justification: Both retain the central claims about learning slow CVs through frozen-BioEmu conditioning and benchmarking three proteins on two downstream tasks. v3 shortens the contribution list by removing a competitive-performance sentence, but retains the corresponding performance and state-discrimination assertions elsewhere.

C2.justification: Removing v2 Appendix C.7 also removes its interpretation that different CV dimensions attend to different descriptors and capture different detailed slow motions. Interpretations of protein sampling failures, dependence on RMSD mixing and incomplete convergence of longer OPES simulations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: The reproducibility statement replaces the anonymous code link with separate links for training/simulation code and simulation-environment setup. Alanine-specific implementation instructions disappear with Appendix C.6. Retained protein hyperparameters, software, hardware and simulation details are unchanged.

R1.justification: References to Holdijk et al. (2023), Kabsch (1976), and Klein and Noé (2024) are removed with the alanine/TBG study. Positioning relative to existing MLCVs, BioEmu and diffusion-model conditioning remains unchanged.

P1.justification: The appendices are substantially reorganized: ablations move from D to B, simulation details become C, and simple-baseline and longer-simulation sections are integrated there; remaining additional results become D. Main-text edits are lighter, including grammar corrections, a shorter title, revised front matter and acknowledgments replacing the LLM-use statement.

P2.justification: Figure 4 becomes a composite display with smaller retained trajectory plots and new Chignolin structural snapshots. v2 Table 11 and Figures 16–17 disappear. Other displays largely retain their designs and content, with appendix relocations, resizing and caption/layout adjustments.

improvement.justification: v3 improves language and documented code/setup access and adds a useful Chignolin illustration, while preserving the central benchmark results. However, it removes nonredundant evidence about an alternative backbone, alanine multipathways and multidimensional CV behavior. These gains and losses do not establish a reliable net quality direction from the PDFs alone.
